_about: Advice for homebrew apps (run through hbloader, program ID 01007ef00011e000) that are known to crash. Keys are lower-case module names from the crash report.

appstore.name: Homebrew App Store
appstore.advice: Older builds of the Homebrew App Store crash on current firmware.
appstore.fix: Update the Homebrew App Store from its GitHub releases, or use a maintained alternative such as sphaira.

themezer-nx.name: Themezer-NX
themezer-nx.advice: Themezer-NX relies on an online service that is no longer running, so it crashes.
themezer-nx.fix: Delete Themezer-NX (switch/Themezer-NX/ or its .nro in switch/).

nx-shell.name: NX-Shell
nx-shell.advice: Old NX-Shell builds are incompatible with current firmware.
nx-shell.fix: Update NX-Shell to the latest release from its GitHub page.

default.advice: Homebrew apps often crash after a firmware or Atmosphère update until they're updated.
default.fix: Update {app} to its latest release, or remove it if it's no longer maintained.
